A highly decentralized, volunteer-run reforestation project that originated in India and now operates heavily in Kenya and Haiti, focusing on planting drought-resistant indigenous trees and building local, sustainable food forests in arid regions.

One of the most prominent US-based grassroots organizations delivering tactical medicine, hospital supplies, and communication equipment directly to the ground in Ukraine, bypassing massive bureaucratic NGOs.

A major US-based non-profit dedicated strictly to humanitarian aid, providing direct relief packages (food, medical supplies, and shelter) to vulnerable populations inside Ukraine and supporting refugees arriving in the US.

A massive coalition of legal advocates, immigration attorneys, and volunteers providing critical, pro-bono legal support for Ukrainians seeking asylum, Temporary Protected Status (TPS), or navigating the "Uniting for Ukraine" sponsorship program.

A grassroots US-based non-profit acting as a vital resource hub, bringing information transparency and resource coordination specifically for Ukrainian refugee resettlement efforts across the US to cut through the complex landscape of government bureaucracies.

A growing grassroots initiative powered entirely by volunteers, providing explicit pro-bono legal information and guidance for those displaced by the war trying to enter or remain in the United States.

Coordinates massive shipments of hygiene supplies, medical gear, and clothing for grassroots mutual aid groups and refugee camps, including heavy logistical support for Ukrainian refugees crossing European borders.

This organization explicitly identifies, vets, and fast-tracks urgent financial support to local, Ukrainian-based grassroots organizations and mutual aid networks on the front lines, ensuring money goes directly to local organizers rather than Western administrative overhead.

While a larger NGO, they operate with a highly decentralized, direct-action framework, deploying immediately to the front lines and border crossings to feed displaced Ukrainians hot meals, frequently partnering with local restaurants and chefs to sustain the local economy.

Heavily crowdsourced and deeply grassroots, this foundation focuses on direct support for military units defending Ukraine, supplying them with essential tactical gear, civilian drones, medical supplies, and vehicles outside the traditional Western defense-contractor pipeline.

While this is the official fundraising platform launched by the Ukrainian government, it is recognized across the progressive/defense space as the most direct, transparent way to fund humanitarian demining efforts, medical aid, and structural rebuilding without losing funds to third-party NGO bloat.
A massive powerhouse of Black and Latino working-class organizing running aggressive, direct-action campaigns for bail reform, tenant rights, and ending ICE collaboration.
The premier national legal organization fighting for Indigenous rights, tribal sovereignty, treaty enforcement, and natural resource protection.
Representative Ilhan Omar’s campaign organization, heavily focused on Medicare for All, housing as a human right, canceling student debt, and anti-imperialist foreign policy.
A grassroots organization founded and run entirely by formerly incarcerated people fighting the carceral state, ending solitary confinement, and restoring voting rights.

A militant, tenant-led campaign across New York (run by the Right to Counsel coalition) pushing to pause winter evictions, guarantee a right to counsel, and prevent landlords from using housing courts to collect rent on unsafe buildings.
Based in Woodburn, Oregon, this grassroots institute develops and supports organizing leadership specifically within underserved farmworker and Latino communities.
Partnered organizations providing crucial affordable housing, workforce training, and mutual aid assistance directly to farmworkers and low-income families in Oregon.
A sister organization of PCUN that promotes economic autonomy, direct mutual aid, and leadership development specifically for immigrant women and farmworkers.
Oregon's leading immigrant rights organization, working to improve the lives of Latinx immigrants through fierce statewide advocacy and grassroots coalition building.
A grassroots, youth-led organization in the Salem-Keizer area focused on developing political leadership among young Latinos and organizing against systemic issues in their schools and communities.
A community-based mutual aid organization in Salem providing essential health, education, and family support resources directly to farmworker and immigrant families.
A grassroots, parent-led civil rights organization fighting for educational equity and dismantling systemic barriers for Latino and immigrant students in Oregon schools.
